#''If this move connects, Devil/Angel will shoot straight "through" the opponent so that he is standing behind the opponent with their back turned. This move does nothing if blocked, and it also does nothing if it connects with an opponent that is not on his/her feet.''
#''The first hit must connect for this move to work; otherwise the user will only perform "Dragon Uppercut"''
#''This move can only connect when an opponent is in the air for whatever reason. In some cases, it can work if the opponent's feet are just barely off of the ground - as with heavier opponents''
